cases.state: Deterministic complex Gaussian-rational pure state, normalized exactly for each n; formula in the script.
cases.identity: D_(2-p)^{tensor n}(rho) = sigma_y^{tensor n} [D_p^{tensor n}(rho)]^T sigma_y^{tensor n}

scope: Finite exact controls supplement the universal algebraic J composed with D_p identity. They do not themselves prove majorization.
physical_range_note: p is replacement noise in D_p=(1-p)id+p tr(.)I/2. For p>1 in the qubit physical range [0,4/3], mirror 2-p lies in [2/3,1]. Some control mirror parameters such as 7/4 lie outside the CP range; those rows check only the algebraic identity, not positivity.
